source: All 15 X1-X3 trials plus v9/v10 architecture evidence

rules.check: No behavioral SRAM arrays; expose paired registered SRAM request/response ports
Per-cycle chunk is signed 12-bit and folded wide state is signed 24-bit
rules.evidence: v9/v10 overflow proof and X1-X3 ~468 MHz wide-add plateau

rules.check: Fold after no more than 16 signed INT4 products
24-bit wide state supports every 16-bit k_dim value
One request produces exactly one accumulation event
rules.evidence: v4 double-count failure preserved by X2/X3 rules

rules.check: 24-bit fold cannot share the multiplier/chunk-add cycle
Residual 1-15 products fold before output drain
Do not shift the 256-word accumulator bank during drain
rules.evidence: X1-Y1 routing failure and X1-Y5 area win

rules.check: Require zero final setup/hold/slew/fanout/cap, DRC, and antenna violations
rules.evidence: X1-Y3 and X2-Y1 extracted max-cap misses

rules.check: External paired requests may depend on registered request state, not issued/k_dim progress comparison
